stories.title: Shelton ends Alcaraz's reign in latest US Open finish, sets up semi vs. Tiafoe
stories.summary: Ben Shelton ended Carlos Alcaraz's title reign in the latest-finishing match in US Open history, pulling out a 6-7 (5), 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-6 (10-7) victory in a marathon tussle that ended at 3:33 a.m. ET.

stories.title: U.S. senator slams SEC over LSU threat: 'Down to the marrow stupid'
stories.summary: U.S. Senator John Kennedy blasted the SEC's threat to expel LSU, saying he and other members of Congress "will be on them like a hobo on a ham sandwich."

stories.title: Sources: LSU closes roster at 105 without adding ex-NFL players
stories.summary: LSU has added two current student-athletes to its roster, closing it at 105 and eliminating the ability to add Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.
